sections.text_helper: Section 25.7.5 "EXTI falling edge pending register (EXTI_FPR1)" in chapter 25 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1137.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x010
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register contains only bits for configurable events.
Bits 31:22 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)
Bits 21:20 FPIFx: configurable event input x falling edge pending bit (x = 21 to 20)
This bit is set when the falling edge event arrives on the configurable event line. This bit is
cleared by writing a 1 into this bit.
0: No falling edge trigger request occurred
1: Falling edge trigger request occurred
l When SECx is disabled in EXTI_SECCFGR1, FPIFx can be accessed with non-secure
and secure access.
l When SECx is enabled in EXTI_SECCFGR1, FPIFx can be accessed only with secure
access. Nonsecure write to FPIFx is discarded. Nonsecure read returns 0.
l When PRIVx is disabled in EXTI_PRIVCFGR1, FPIFx can be accessed with unprivileged
and privileged access.
l When PRIVx is enabled in EXTI_PRIVCFGR1, FPIFx can be accessed only with
privileged access. Unprivileged write to FPIFx is discarded. Unprivileged read returns 0.
Bits 19:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 FPIFx: Configurable event input x rising edge pending bit (x = 15 to 0)
